paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
suggested_experiment_name: GBT L/S-band model-independent radio DM search (Keller et al.)
coupling_convention: dark matter decay rate Lambda in s^-1 (solid line, 1-photon final state), plotted as on y-axis; NOT g_agamma
notes: This is a model-independent radio-line dark matter search (Breakthrough Listen/GBT) that sets limits on the DM DECAY RATE lambda (~1e-32 s^-1) and the velocity-weighted ANNIHILATION cross section <sigma v> (~1e-30 cm^3 s^-1) over 1020-2700 MHz. It is explicitly model-independent and does NOT report an axion-photon coupling g_agamma or any coupling in the provided enum; therefore coupling_type is null. The y-axis of the exclusion plots (Fig. 8, 9) is lambda in s^-1 (or <sigma v> in cm^3 s^-1), not a coupling. The pre-analysis hint of AxionPhoton is overridden. Local density used: rho_NFW(rs)=0.471 GeV/cm^3 (Burkert 0.487). Photon energy relation h*nu = m_chi c^2/2, so masses would span ~8.4e-6 to 2.2e-5 eV, but no coupling mapping exists.
